brief: A portable electronics organizer: a base with removable bins for small parts, at least one drawer, and a carry handle.

finish.summary: Three-cell organizer, all joined with joint bolts: a north half base holding a drawer, a full base with a 3-compartment bin under a top cover that carries the carry handle, and a full base at the south end with an open 2-compartment bin. check_build: no rule errors, meshClash "clear". 9 open side faces could still take optional caps (info only).

requirements.evidence: piece:0,-1,0;half-s, piece:0,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full joined by jointBolt:0#0,-1#5 and jointBolt:0#0,0#5.

bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3 (3 compartments, under the handle cover) and bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2 compartments, open top). This checks fit only. The configurator does not test how easy the bins are to lift out.
drawer:0#0,-1#cut on the cut face of the half base, with cover:0,-1,0;half-s;top above it.
handle:0,0,0;top on cover:0,0,0;full;top, fixed with 3 inserts. It sits on the middle cell. Fit is checked, but no load rating is claimed.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
